```yaml
name: Nightly Release

on:
  schedule:
    - cron: "0 2 * * *"
  workflow_dispatch:

jobs:
  release:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          fetch-depth: 0

      - name: Set up Python
        uses: actions/setup-python@v4
        with:
          python-version: "3.10"

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: |
          python -m pip install --upgrade pip
          pip install commitizen
          pip install -e .

      - name: Check for release needed
        id: check_release
        run: |
          # Check if there are any commits since last tag that match bump pattern
          LAST_TAG=$(git describe --tags --abbrev=0 2>/dev/null || echo "v0.0.0")
          COMMITS_SINCE_LAST_TAG=$(git log --oneline ${LAST_TAG}..HEAD | wc -l)
          
          if [ "$COMMITS_SINCE_LAST_TAG" -gt 0 ]; then
            echo "release_needed=true" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
            echo "commits_since_last_tag=$COMMITS_SINCE_LAST_TAG" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
          else
            echo "release_needed=false" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
          fi

      - name: Bump version and generate changelog
        if: steps.check_release.outputs.release_needed == 'true'
        run: |
          cz bump --changelog --check-consistency
          git config user.name github-actions[bot]
          git config user.email github-actions[bot]@users.noreply.github.com
          git add .
          git commit -m "chore(release): bump version and update changelog" || echo "No changes to commit"
          git push origin HEAD:main

      - name: Create GitHub Release
        if: steps.check_release.outputs.release_needed == 'true'
        uses: actions/create-release@v1
        env:
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
        with:
          tag_name: v0.0.0
          release_name: Release v0.0.0
          body_path: CHANGELOG.md
          draft: false
          prerelease: false
```
